Professional Summary Seasoned Program Manager and AI enthusiast with extensive experience leading enterprise AI-driven digital transformation programs across Asset & Wealth Management and Payments ecosystems. Expertise in delivering AI/ML analytics platforms, data modernization, and payment innovations including UPI, DCMS, ACS, and cross-border payments, ensuring compliance with RBI and NPCI regulatory frameworks.
